title: Effects of Upper Extremity Rehabilitation Robot and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation Among Patients With Stroke
brief_summary: Effects of upper extremity rehabilitation robot and transcranial direct current stimulation on upper extremity function among subjects with tremor after stroke
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Stroke with cerebellar hemorrhage or infarction
* ataxia or tremor on upper extremities secondary to stroke
* Cognitively intact enough to understand and follow the instructions from the investigator

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of surgery of affected upper limb
* Fracture of affected upper limb
